fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro Copy
fields.value: Apply for the PRPL cohort-based leadership seminar for professionals responding to missing and exploited child cases.

fields.name: formAction
fields.label: Submit Endpoint URL
fields.description: Use http://127.0.0.1:8787/prpl-application for local mock testing. The original form is hosted in Asana and does not expose stable browser-submit field names, so production native submits should use a backend endpoint/proxy.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Success Message
fields.value: Thank you. Your PRPL application has been submitted.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.label: Error Message
fields.value: We could not submit your application. Please try again.

fields.name: topPadding
fields.label: Top Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Accepts CSS lengths like 64px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.

fields.name: submissionMode
fields.label: Submission Mode
fields.description: Native Form posts the redesigned form to the backend endpoint. Original Asana Embed renders the hosted Asana form.

fields.name: embedUrl
fields.label: Original Asana Embed URL
fields.description: Used only when Submission Mode is Original Asana Embed.
